thread:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — while testing the Optimize toolkit examples I hit a weird quant profile edge case when sequence length is 0 for batched inputs. Repro steps below.

Raj Patel: Oh interesting, can you paste the minimal payload? :eyes:

Mia Chen: Sure — sending the snippet I used (this is the SDK-friendly example):
```json
{"requests": [{"id": "r1", "input": "", "seq_len": 0}, {"id": "r2", "input": "short prompt", "seq_len": 12}], "batch_size": 2, "quant_profile": "default-q4"}
```

Oliver Park: Hmm — the runtime assumed seq_len >= 1 in the profile transformer math, so prefix cache logic short-circuits incorrectly. Did you see an error or just degraded outputs?

Mia Chen: No thrown exception, just outputs that look like full-context repeats for r1 (garbled). r2 looks fine.

Lina Gómez: Thanks for catching. We should add a short note in the Optimize toolkit guide about "empty prompt handling" for batching/quant combos. Could also add an SDK snippet that normalizes seq_len.

Raj Patel: Agree. Proposed doc change: small subsection under batching gotcha -> "empty or zero-length inputs" with code to sanitize. Example patch: 
```python
# normalize inputs before send
for r in requests:
    if not r.get("input"):
        r["input"] = "\n"  # minimal token to avoid seq_len==0 path
```

Oliver Park: That hack is fine as a short-term, but prefer a note recommending `prefill=true` or `kv_prefetch` (Optimize toolkit setting) to avoid unexpected cache branches. Also file an infra bug to not assume seq_len >=1.

Mia Chen: I'll open the docs PR and the infra ticket. Draft PR checklist: 1) add subsection + code snippet, 2) add test vector in examples repo, 3) update quant-profile troubleshooting matrix with expected behavior.

Lina Gómez: Can you ping @Oliver once PR is up? I can help polish wording and add link to SDK quick-fix. :thumbsup:

Mia Chen: Will do. PR drafted at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/864 — still WIP.

docs-bot: New PR opened by Mia Chen: docs/pull/864 — title: "Optimize toolkit: document zero-length input edge case for quant/batch". CI checks queued.

Raj Patel: Quick review items for docs PR: keep code examples minimal, add rationale sentence about batch routing, and add a compatibility note for 2.0 vs legacy quant profiles.

Oliver Park: Filed infra issue INF-4721 to adjust runtime guard and added link in the PR description.

Mia Chen: Thanks all — I'll iterate on the PR tonight and ping for reviews.

Lina Gómez: Thanks — once merged, let's add a redirect in the quickstart so users land on the note when they search "empty prompt".

Mia Chen: Added a follow-up TODO in the PR for redirect. Closing thread for now, will report back after merge. :sparkles:
